steps.title: Given the custom brand "Licter" is selected with a full URL as website and a market
steps.expected: "licter.com" is shown under the brand name with its logo preview (logo noted as L1)
steps.observed: Brand analysis chosen; "Licter — Custom Brand" row selected (not the Brandfetch suggestion "Licter licter.com"); website typed "https://www.licter.com/fr/about?x=1"; United States / English (EN) saved. Brand card shows "Licter" + "licter.com" with logo preview L1 = https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (Google favicon, 64x64, redirects to t2.gstatic.com faviconV2). GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com -> 200 {"domain":"licter.com"} (no logoUrl: Brandfetch brand-profile quota still exhausted).

steps.title: And the user clicks "Discover Categories" and checks the category discovery request in DevTools
steps.expected: The brand domain sent (entityDomain) is "licter.com", not the full URL typed (the Summary step shows neither the brand nor its domain)
steps.observed: POST /geo/api/v1/analysis/discover-categories -> 200, body {"entityName":"Licter","entityDomain":"licter.com","insightsLanguage":"en","markets":[{"countryCode":"US","languageCode":"en",...,"isPrimary":true}]}. Categories proposed: Social Listening Tools, Audience Intelligence Platforms (+ Overview).

steps.title: When the user goes through Categories, Prompts and Summary and creates the analysis
steps.data: Default categories, only 5 prompts kept (QA rule: test analyses keep 5 prompts, shared prompt pool)
steps.expected: The analysis A1 is created and "View analysis" is available
steps.observed: BLOCKED by the prompt pool. Pool before the run 996 / 1000 (11 analyses). Generate Prompts -> 70 preselected, pool "1066 / 1000 · 70 selected", "66 prompts over. Untick prompts or contact your account manager.". After unticking all and keeping 5 (1 Overview, 2 Social Listening Tools, 2 Audience Intelligence Platforms): "1001 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected" + "1 prompt over. Untick prompts or contact your account manager." and the "Review & Launch" button stays disabled. Run stopped as instructed: no other analysis touched, A1 NOT created.

steps.title: And the user checks the analysis creation request in DevTools
steps.expected: The brand domain sent and returned is "licter.com", not the full URL typed
steps.observed: Not reached: creation blocked by the prompt pool (1001 / 1000 with 5 prompts).

steps.title: And the user opens the analysis from "View analysis"

steps.expected: The sidebar and header show logo L1 of licter.com, not a lettermark

results.notes: Steps 1-2 PASS (derived domain "licter.com" shown on the card and sent as entityDomain in discover-categories).
